text:
kevin: Quick heads-up 
I uploaded the initial Novaloop RFI packet to /deals/novaloop/rfi. Buyer asks: explicit POC throughput, on-prem HSM options, private peering diagram, three pricing bands + single-month dedicated POC fee, and a short sample liability clause for egress. Can security/ops/finance review wording by EOD tomorrow?

tara: I'll take the capability matrix and mark operational caveats (quantization accuracy, fallback routing). Note: call out that streaming + tool-calling are available in hosted; Dedicated has configurable latency SLOs.

mike: Ops: POC throughput depends on model family and prompt distribution. Suggested conservative numbers we can quote in the RFI:
- nova-13b on 4xA100: ~370 req/s (16 token avg)
- nova-70b on 8xA100 equiv: ~92 req/s (16 token avg)
- embedding-only on 2xA100: ~1,200 req/s
I'll paste a tiny CSV snippet and a short assumptions line.

liz: Security: HSM/KMS copy we should standardize: Private = BYO-HSM (PKCS#11) + optional private control plane; Dedicated = cloud KMS / CMEK supported; Hosted = cloud KMS only (we don't persist raw key material). I'll add a short FedRAMP mapping note and mention attestation.

legal-bot: Reminder: Novaloop RFI deadline 2025-06-21 17:00 UTC. Attach final artifacts to /deals/novaloop/rfi/FINAL for archives.

mike: CSV snippet (paste):

```
model,instance,baseline_reqs_s,burst_reqs_s,assumptions
nova-13b,4xA100,370,650,16 tok avg; warmed KV cache
nova-70b,8xA100,92,170,16 tok avg; large-context opts
nova-embed,2xA100,1200,2000,embedding-only workload
```

kevin: Liz, can you drop the short HSM paragraph here? I'll consolidate into the RFI doc.

liz: Draft HSM paragraph:

"Private deployments: support customer-provided HSMs via PKCS#11/NSS with an integration guide and recommended attestation steps; customer responsible for HSM lifecycle. Dedicated: supports cloud KMS (CMEK) with customer key ownership. Hosted: integrates with provider KMS only; we do not access or persist raw key material. For customers requiring FIPS-validated HSMs, Private deployment is recommended."

tara: Two buyer blockers they flagged: 1) legal wants a proposed egress liability cap and sample wording; 2) infra wants a POC->prod runbook. Who owns the runbook?

mike: Ops will own the runbook. I'll draft a 2-page runbook (warmup steps, autoscale toggles, rollback checklist) and include `kubectl` snippets for the autoscaler.

kevin: Finance ask: buyer requested price bands for 5k / 50k / 500k tokens/mo and a single-month dedicated POC price. Liz/Tara can you mark anything that should impact pricing (e.g., private control plane add-on)?

liz: Private control plane and BYO-HSM are enterprise add-ons, call them out as line items. Also include region-lock option for Dedicated/Private (eu-west-1) but note control plane caveat: console/analytics may remain in our control plane unless they buy the private control plane option.

ops-bot: Note: route:region policy supports region pinning for Dedicated/Private. Control plane locality requires private control plane purchase.

kevin: Legal sample egress clause draft (quick):

"Customer liability for data egress resulting from the POC is capped at the greater of $50,000 or three (3) months of expected subscription fees, unless otherwise agreed in writing. This cap applies solely to direct damages arising from egress events; indirect or consequential damages are excluded per standard terms."

legal-bot: Flag: confirm with Legal counsel before sending; different regions may require alternate language.

mike: I'll attach the runbook skeleton by EOD. Tara: can you mark "fallback routing" as a caveat row in the matrix?

tara: Yep, I'll annotate the capability_matrix.csv. Wording suggestion: "If Dedicated capacity is exhausted, traffic may be routed to a compatible hosted variant with adjusted SLA and latency characteristics." Mark as caveat.

kevin: Action items:
- liz: finalize HSM paragraph + FedRAMP control mapping (due Tue EOD)
- mike: finalize throughput CSV + draft runbook (due Tue noon)
- tara: annotate capability matrix with caveats + fallback line (due Tue noon)
- finance (cc @sam-finance in thread): provide 5k/50k/500k bands + single-month dedicated POC price and line-item for private control plane (due Tue EOD)

sam-finance: I'll post a quick cost table later today (ballpark). Tentative: hosted base X, dedicated +25%, private control plane add-on flat fee.

kevin: Great. I'll assemble the final RFI packet once all pieces are in and kick off a 20m sign-off tomorrow 10:30am. If anything blocks, post here. :thumbsup:
